articles.title: tester-army/e2e
articles.excerpt: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.
articles.summary: 面向 Web 与移动应用的下一代端到端（e2e）测试框架，目标是统一浏览器与原生 App 的自动化测试流程，减少多套工具链来回切换的成本。适合需要同时覆盖网页和移动端回归测试的前端与 QA 团队，用来编写和维护跨平台测试用例。

articles.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
articles.excerpt: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
articles.summary: 为 AI 编码 agent 提供跨会话的持久记忆：自动记录 agent 在会话中的操作，用 AI 压缩成摘要，并在后续会话中把相关上下文重新注入。兼容 Claude 等工具，解决长任务中上下文丢失、每次重来的问题，适合长期维护项目或需连续多轮协作的开发者。

articles.title: earthtojake/text-to-cad
articles.excerpt: Give your agent CAD superpowers.
articles.summary: 让 AI agent 获得 CAD 建模能力。从仓库名推测，项目把自然语言指令转成 CAD 操作，使 agent 能直接生成或修改三维模型，而不必在专业软件里手工建模。适合希望用文本驱动参数化设计、做快速原型验证的机械与硬件工程师。

articles.title: pingdotgg/t3code
articles.summary: 仓库未提供描述，仅凭仓库名 t3code 无法确认具体功能；从维护者 pingdotgg 与 t3 命名推测，可能与 T3 技术栈相关的代码生成或开发工具链有关。信息不足，建议直接查看 README 与源码确认用途。

articles.title: boykopovar/AnyPS5
articles.excerpt: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
articles.summary: 把 PS5 可执行程序自动移植到 Linux 与 Windows 的工具，面向希望在 PC 上运行 PlayStation 5 二进制的人群。它通过自动处理平台相关的加载方式、系统调用与依赖差异，降低手工移植成本，属于主机兼容与模拟方向的实验性项目。

articles.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
articles.excerpt: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
articles.summary: 一个命令行工具，让 AI agent 能读取和搜索互联网内容，覆盖 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、B 站、小红书等平台，且不依赖付费 API。适合需要抓取社交平台公开信息做调研、舆情监控或内容整理的 agent 应用与开发者。

articles.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
articles.excerpt: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
articles.summary: 开源、由 agent 驱动的视频制作系统：内置 12 条生产流水线、100 多个工具，以及 700 多份 agent 技能与制作知识文件，把 AI 编码助手变成完整的视频生产团队。适合用自动化方式完成从脚本、素材到成片流程的内容创作者。

articles.title: caddyserver/caddy
articles.excerpt: Fast and extensible multi-platform HTTP/1-2-3 web server with automatic HTTPS
articles.summary: 用 Go 编写的多平台 HTTP/1、HTTP/2、HTTP/3 Web 服务器，最大特色是自动 HTTPS：自动申请并续期 Let's Encrypt 证书，配置极简。通过 Caddyfile 或 JSON 配置驱动，常被用作反向代理、静态站点托管和本地开发服务器。

articles.title: DuarteSantos8/openGym
articles.excerpt: Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.
articles.summary: 自托管的健身与自重训练记录工具，可编排训练计划，记录含超级组、热身组和有氧的训练内容，并展示各肌群处于已训练、疲劳还是退化状态。支持从 FitNotes、Strong、Hevy 导入数据与 passkey 登录，适合注重数据私有化的健身爱好者。

articles.title: cloudflare/cloudflare-os
articles.excerpt: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.
articles.summary: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 agent 工作空间，用于在企业的上下文与内部系统之上创建文档、构建应用和运行 agent。它把公司知识与业务系统接入 agent，让员工用自然语言完成写作与应用搭建，适合已在 Cloudflare 上开发的企业团队。

articles.title: Stremio/stremio-web
articles.excerpt: Stremio - Freedom to Stream
articles.summary: Stremio 的开源网页客户端，直接在浏览器里观看流媒体内容，无需安装桌面版。用户可通过插件式 addon 聚合不同来源的影片，形成统一的播放入口和媒体库。适合想在多设备上轻量使用 Stremio、避免本地安装的用户。

articles.title: msitarzewski/agency-agents
articles.excerpt: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
articles.summary: 一套开箱即用的 AI「代理机构」：把前端开发、Reddit 社区运营、创意注入、现实校验等角色拆成各自独立的 agent，每个都带人格设定、工作流程和专属技能。适合想组建多角色 AI 工作流的开发者，用于内容生产、社区运营或产品开发。

articles.title: M-Abozaid/esp32-c3-adblock
articles.excerpt: Pi-hole-class DNS ad-blocker on a $2 ESP32-C3 (no PSRAM): 537k domains as 40-bit FNV-1a hashes in flash, binary-searched. UDP DNS sinkhole + web dashboard. https://youtube.com/shorts/RaxszOUMi8E?feature=share
articles.summary: 把 Pi-hole 级别的 DNS 广告拦截塞进 2 美元的 ESP32-C3：将 53.7 万个域名以 40 位 FNV-1a 哈希存入 flash 并二分查找，实现 UDP DNS sinkhole，附 Web 管理面板。无 PSRAM 也能运行，适合用极低成本搭建家庭网络去广告。

articles.title: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns
articles.excerpt: A year after announcing our goal to hire 1,111 interns, more than 750 early-career builders have shipped real products across 48 teams at Cloudflare. From Birthday Week launches to post-quantum security, our interns prove that AI amplifies human potential instead of replacing it.

articles.title: 8 major updates to Cloudflare Observability
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is launching eight major updates that bring logs, traces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, querying, and telemetry export into one observability platform, with simpler and more predictable pricing.

articles.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers
articles.excerpt: Streamline demonstrates how to build long-running, continuous video processing pipelines by pairing Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects with a containerized media engine.

articles.title: Introducing Web Search API via AI Gateway
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare AI Gateway now supports native web search API integration in partnership with Ceramic.ai, Exa, and Linkup. Developers can now inject real-time web context into model inference calls via AI Gateway, REST APIs, or Workers bindings.

articles.title: Introducing Cloudflare Traces: follow requests through our entire platform
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Traces shows how a request moves through security rules, transformations, cache, routing, Workers, and your origin, then follows it across services running anywhere in your stack.

articles.title: Updates on our pledge to make Cloudflare features accessible to everyone
articles.excerpt: A year after pledging to eliminate two-tier product access, Cloudflare has expanded Logpush, multi-account governance, and higher platform limits to all accounts. Here is an update on our progress, how we dogfood these tools internally, and what is coming next.

articles.excerpt: We’re announcing the closed beta of a self-serve Cloudflare OHTTP Gateway. We’re also renaming our Privacy Gateway to Cloudflare OHTTP Relay to better distinguish the two products.

articles.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
articles.excerpt: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

articles.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
articles.excerpt: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.

articles.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare
articles.excerpt: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.

articles.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks. By incorporating background telemetry from Cloudflare Challenge Pages, we have expanded our real-user measurement scale while maintaining user privacy.

articles.title: Introducing Clef: our open-source decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform

articles.title: One year later: Sovereign AI and the fight for choice
articles.excerpt: AI sovereignty is not a zero-sum game, but many governments now believe it is. Cloudflare's answer: more local open-source models, model-agnostic security tools, and a commitment to giving nations genuine choice.

articles.title: Introducing Workers KV Instant — powered by Quicksilver
articles.excerpt: Workers KV Instant delivers sub-2ms p99 read latencies and 250ms global replication across Cloudflare’s 300+ edge locations. KV Instant eliminates cold-read penalties and uses the familiar Workers KV API.

articles.title: Cloudflare OS: your company’s agent workspace, managed for you
